searchText: Fix is here: https://github.com/lightclient/go-ethereum/pull/22 ping me when its merged. <@425572898787426305> We ( <@554799849288105986> and I) discussed about https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/main/src/engine/specification.md#specification-1 today. The spec says: - if shanghai && withdrawals == nil -> return INVALID - if !shanghai && withdrawals != nil -> return INVALID There are two cases missing - if shanghai && withdrawals != nil -> return valid (intuitive) - if !shanghai && withdrawals == nil -> return ? I interpreted that as we should return INVALID then, but everyone else seems to agree that we should return valid (and I agree). I think it should be made more clear in the spec that this method can be called before the fork with non-withdrawal blocks The spec only enumerates cases that require invalid. If a block makes it through all the invalidation conditions, it is valid. You wouldn't also enumerate all valid cases. Also withdrawals wouldn't be nullible if there wasn't a valid case where it is null. That's how I interpret it anyway The spec as it is today is clear and precise in regards to that issue IMO

There are two cases missing

- if !shanghai && withdrawals == nil -> return ?
